trace.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT t, c
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WITH t, c, collect(o.name) AS owners
WHERE ((CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND NOT ('Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall' IN owners)) OR ('Atlanta Spirit LLC' IN owners AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967))
RETURN c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
